$comment: Bounded waiver for the Production E2E gate — CURRENTLY EMPTY.
The gate is green at the root: every failure has been fixed, rewritten, or
moved to the non-blocking @runtime suite. Nothing is waived.
RULES ENFORCED BY scripts/e2e-gate.mjs (kept live for the next time):
1. A waived test still RUNS. Nothing is skipped or deleted.
2. Past `expires`, the gate FAILS on the waiver itself. It cannot rot.
3. A waived test that starts PASSING fails the gate until it is removed
— unless marked `unstable`, which means it is waived because it flaps.
4. Any failure NOT listed here fails the gate normally.
5. Window capped at 30 days; policy path hard-coded in the script.
6. Entries are keyed on file + test title, never on line numbers.
History: Production E2E had never been green — 0 successes in 405 runs since
2026-05-17. main @ b2ee7c88 = 57 failed / 177 passed. First green: run
31704457154. The waiver peaked at 20 entries and was worked down to 0 by
fixing root causes, notably:
- defaultIdeSettingsState() hard-coded theme:'dark', so any project without
saved IDE settings forced the IDE dark and persisted it to bolt_theme.
- AUTH_REGISTER_RATE_LIMIT_MAX (10/min/IP) saturated by per-test signups,
which made a DIFFERENT test fail on every run.
- getComputedStyle returns "" on detached nodes: theme/layout measurements
now re-resolve their locator inside toPass().
- a long tail of labels that drifted (Files -> Library, 'Env vars' ->
'Environment variables', 'Open the files panel', deployments panel, the
checkpoint flow, statusbar metrics).
- section 12 measured the add-tab '+' button, which a dedicated rule rounds
to 6px, instead of a regular tab action carrying the 4px button token.
